snippet.title: As We Descend - Launch Trailer | Early Access
snippet.description:
As We Descend is available on Steam right now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1769830/As_We_Descend/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=launch_trailer_ea&utm_medium=video

As We Descend is a roguelike deckbuilder with the soul of a strategy game. Find salvation for the last City of humankind, and descend all the way to the core.
